atoms.name: Global extrema on an interval
atoms.one_line: Compare critical values with endpoint values.

atoms.name: Convexity
atoms.one_line: $f''>0$: any critical point is the unique global minimum.

atoms.name: Word problems
atoms.one_line: Reduce to one variable, then set the derivative to zero.

atoms.name: Counting extrema
atoms.one_line: Extrema need a sign change of $f'$; repeated roots do not count.

atoms.name: Monotonicity and inflection
atoms.one_line: $f'$ sign gives increase or decrease; $f'$ is extreme where $f''=0$ changes sign.

atoms.name: Non-polynomial functions
atoms.one_line: Use products, logs and $e^x$; log-differentiate for $x^{g(x)}$.

patterns.name: Classify critical points of a polynomial
